title: Multi-domain semantic segmentation with overlapping labels
mechanism: Universal taxonomy where each dataset class is a union of universal classes; one softmax over universal classes trained with a partial-label NLL (log of summed probability over the union).
evidence: Competitive within- and cross-dataset, state of the art on WildDash 2; learns concepts never labelled separately in any training dataset.
adaptation: Universal classes = our 24 plus UCF/MSS classes with no BenchmarkEL counterpart (contact, interconnect). Hand-written dataset-to-universal map (UCF crack = {crack, inactive}). Use as the formal version of the marginal-loss arm.
min_experiment: Same as marginal-loss arm (Arm B) but with the universal-taxonomy NLL; 5 seeds, 30k steps vs house 5-seed; kill line as MultiTalent arm. Shares GPU budget with Arm B.

alt_notes.adaptation: Joint training with UCF-EL 9,562 cells: UCF crack -> log(p_crack + p_inactive); contact/interconnect mapped to ribbon/busbar groups after an eyeball check on ~20 cells; BenchmarkEL loss unchanged.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm PF + UCF-EL 1:1 batches under union loss; baseline PF; metrics E1 crack recall and relF1@2, inactive IoU; kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.02 or test crack IoU drop > 0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Joint training with UCF-EL's 9,562 cells. UCF 'crack' is trained as log(p_crack + p_inactive). UCF contact and interconnect map to the busbar and ribbon groups; check this mapping by eye on 20 cells, with no relabelling. The BenchmarkEL loss is unchanged. This keeps UCF information in the model, unlike the old pretraining that the fine-tune erased.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF jointly trained with UCF-EL (1:1 batches) under the union loss. Baseline: PF. Metrics: E1 crack recall and relF1@2, inactive IoU, test crack IoU. Kill if the E1 relF1@2 gain is < 0.02 or test crack IoU drops by more than 0.012.
